repairs.cause: The independent CPU HF model used BF16 pointwise intermediates instead of the frozen A3 execution boundaries. RoPE uses FP32 intermediates (104448 bit-exact outputs); clipped SwiGLU uses FP32 intermediates (196608 outputs within the unchanged tolerance). Use standard CPU SDPA and the same prefill/decode history, with these independently proven storage boundaries. B low-rank branch already matches the independent BF16 oracle exactly in all 48 calls, and a fresh unobserved B engine matches the switched B tokens/logprobs exactly. No production change, weight change, gate deletion or tolerance change. All old source-dependent results must be invalidated and rerun; retain the original failed P7 receipt.
